conventions: Preserve existing Apache 2.0 license headers and copyright years unchanged on all existing files.
Edit only TSDoc comments (/** ... */); never modify executable code, imports, exports, type signatures, parameter names, return types, or release tags (@public, @alpha, @deprecated).

Follow @backstage/catalog-model TSDoc conventions: a summary sentence, optional @remarks block separated by blank lines, release tag (@public) on top-level exports, followed by @param <name> - <description> and @returns <description> on functions/methods, using {@link ...} for symbol references.
Do not add release tags (@public or @alpha) to interface members or class methods whose enclosing interface or class already carries @public.
Format modified files with yarn prettier --write; never run eslint --fix or hand-edit report*.api.md files.

decisions.topic: TSDoc block placement on conditions.ts type guards
decisions.choice: Edit the existing single-tag /** @public */ block in place above each of the 8 exported type guard functions to include the summary, @public tag, @param entity, and @returns
rejected: Adding a second doc comment block above /** @public */
decisions.reason: API Extractor reads the single TSDoc comment block immediately preceding each exported declaration and requires the @public release tag to stay intact.

decisions.choice: Add concise /** ... */ doc comments above apiVersion, kind, and spec on each *EntityV1alpha1 interface matching the style of Entity in src/entity/Entity.ts without adding release tags or nested spec property comments
decisions.reason: Interface members inherit the release tag of their enclosing @public interface, and API Extractor only marks top-level apiVersion, kind, and spec as (undocumented) in report.api.md.

decisions.topic: TSDoc on EntityPolicy.enforce implementations and KubernetesValidatorFunctions static methods
decisions.choice: Add /** ... */ doc comments with summary, @param, and @returns above each enforce method in src/entity/policies/*EntityPolicy.ts and each static method in KubernetesValidatorFunctions.ts accurately describing its runtime behavior
rejected: Copying generic interface documentation without policy-specific or validator-specific details
decisions.reason: Requirements FR-10 through FR-15 and AC-3 require every TSDoc comment to state what the implementation in its source file actually does.

decisions.choice: Create .changeset/catalog-model-tsdoc.md with '@backstage/catalog-model': patch and an adopter-facing summary of the TSDoc additions
decisions.reason: TSDoc comments ship in published .d.ts files without changing runtime behavior, and Gate 0 froze a patch changeset for @backstage/catalog-model.
